title: Clarify queue hierarchy, actions, and allocation state
objective: Implement the remaining high-value UI polish from the FEEDBACK-07 design direction: non-alarmist critical-band wording, unmistakable collapsed state, readable remaining/over-capacity hierarchy without gray washout, opaque readable More menus, hover/focus tooltips for icon actions, simplified row action cluster, explicit allocation overflow, and visible duration-memory state.

implementation.A15_band_wording: model/bands.ts notes: Critical 'do today', High 'soon', Everything else 'when room'. Urgency tier logic untouched; no alarmist copy.
implementation.A11_collapse_state: BandHeader/DroppedHeader render a visible band__state chip (expanded/collapsed), count gains ' hidden', header gets band--collapsed surface shift, and aria-label announces 'Band X, collapsed, N rows hidden, activate to expand' (and the expanded counterpart).
implementation.A10_over_capacity_hierarchy: Queue renders queue__remaining (role=status) above bands when selected exceeds capacity: 'X blk selected of Y capacity - Z over' with overflow color and strong weight; balanced days render nothing.
implementation.LP01_row_hierarchy: qrow--flagged and qrow--excluded no longer use whole-row opacity. Flagged rows get an overflow tint + badge chip; excluded rows drop to a muted-but-readable name; the would-drop badge is a bordered chip.
implementation.A13_action_simplification: Place at a specific time and Unschedule moved from row icons into the More menu (conditional on queue state; recurring rows stay placement-immune). Row cluster is now exclude + exact-duration + divider + Done + Drop + More.
implementation.A14_more_menu: row-more__menu now uses solid var(--t-surface) background with border, z-index 12, and shadow; ArrowDown/ArrowUp move focus between menuitems; Escape closes and refocuses the trigger.
implementation.A12_tooltips: New shared ui/Tooltip.tsx: hover + focus label popover for every icon action (exclude, exact duration, +/- steppers, More trigger), role=tooltip, aria-describedby wiring, align=end for the right-edge More trigger. Native title attributes removed from row icons.
implementation.A08_duration_source: Every duration slider's aria-valuetext is 'HH:MM (source|memory)' and a visible qrow__src-tag chip (source quiet, memory accent-tinted) sits beside the value; the * marker stays.
implementation.A09_overflow_caption: AllocationPie renders pie__over-caption 'Over by X blk - trim or drop' (role=status, overflow color) when allocated exceeds the day.

updated: frontend/src/ui/components.test.tsx: placement path now opens More first (A13 intent)
coverage: collapsed band + Dropped header announce state and hidden count, reverse on expand (A11)
over-capacity summary present when over, absent when balanced (A10)
flagged rows keep name + badge; CSS guard blocks whole-row opacity (LP-01)
row no longer renders placement verb directly; Place/Unschedule live in More and keep their effects (A13)
Unassign/Delete stay in More; frozen verb model intact
More menu solid surface + border + z-index (A14)
tooltip on hover and focus for exclude/exact-duration icons (A12)
duration source chip and aria-valuetext source/memory (A08)
